notes: 2024-11-15 - Intro call (Maya + Rafael): Argento is a mid-sized e-discovery / compliance vendor focused on regulated EU legal teams. Wants RAG for document discovery across litigation & regulatory response.
Key ask: private deployment (VPC) with audit logs retained 7 years; data must remain in EU regions. SSO + SCIM mandatory.

Scale: estimate ~30M documents (email + contracts + filings). Average doc size ~12KB; attachments (PDFs) push raw store to ~3TB. Embedding plan: 1536-dim vectors (open model baseline). Estimated dense index ~200GB (float32) or ~40-80GB with quantization.
Performance targets: interactive search latency: P95 <200ms, P99 <450ms end-to-end for single-query doc search + rerank. Throughput: 50 qps steady-state, burst to 200 qps for e-discovery runs.

Relevance strategy: ANN retrieval -> candidate K=100 -> lightweight cross-encoder reranker (top 8-10). Want configurable rerank depth to trade cost vs quality. POC will evaluate recall vs cost per query.
Cost expectations: internal target < $0.10/query average (including retrieval + embed + rerank). Willing to accept higher during heavy batch jobs if queued/prioritized.

Security & compliance: DPA + processor terms required. ISO27001 evidence requested; SOC2 report required for Dedicated/Private. Need KMS/HSM integration for key control. Full audit trail (who queried what, token-level) must be exportable.

POC scope agreed 2024-12-05: index 500k representative docs (samples + live subset), run 1 baseline retrieval model (BM25), 1 dense retriever (open-embed), and 2 rerankers (small cross-encoder + optimized distilled model). Measure latency, recall@10, cost/query. Deliverable: ops runbook for production indexing and SLOs.

Technical notes from deep-dive (2024-12-02): network: strict egress rules, prefer Private with no public endpoints. Customer willing to provision subnet peering. On-prem option if required for sensitive clients.
Quote from CTO: "We need predictable economics and audit trails; if we can't prove retention and query logs for 7 years we won't pass counsel sign-off."
Sales friction: procurement wants references from other legal customers and recent ISO/SOC evidence. Legal flagged retention + deletion policy alignment with EU regs.

Action items: Redwood to provide architecture diagram for VPC Private deployment, sample retention + audit export format, and preliminary cost model for 30M doc index. SE to run quick benchmark for 100k docs and share latency profile by qps.

technical_summary: Indexing scale: planned 30M docs; expected vector index 150-250GB (float32) before quantization; attachment store ~3TB.
Embedding strategy: chunking at ~1k tokens, 1536-dim embeddings baseline (open), option to switch to 768-dim quantized for cost reduction.
Retrieval & rerank: ANN (HNSW or IVFFlat) for recall -> candidate K=100 -> cross-encoder rerank top 8; aim to batch reranker for amortized GPU cost.
Latency/throughput targets: P95 <200ms, P99 <450ms, steady 50 qps, burst 200 qps. Need autoscale policy for batch backfill jobs.
Cost controls: recommend prefix caching for common queries, dynamic rerank depth, and quantized embeddings to meet < $0.10/query target.
Operational needs: audit log exports (per-query user, timestamp, model version), long-term retention (7 yrs), KMS integration, SSO/SCIM provisioning.
